reason: A at least proposes extending controlled nanoprecipitation processing to a refractory alloy and provides a comparative, falsifiable aging experiment, although it is compositionally vague and incorrectly conflates coherent-particle strengthening with Orowan bypass. B is more specific and physically demonstrated, but it essentially reproduces the intervention, microstructure, mechanism, and performance already reported in its cited W-based alloy study, so it offers no substantive new proposal.
